content: brainrender 2.1.20 (installed; PyPI latest is 2.2.0, no forced upgrade needed) brainrender.actors.Points(data, name=None, colors='salmon', alpha=1, radius=20, res=8) takes an Nx3 numpy array (or path to .npy) of point coordinates in the Scene atlas' voxel/micron space. brainglobe-atlasapi's allen_mouse_10um atlas (installed, matches ABBA's allen_mouse_10um_java) has resolution (10,10,10) micron voxels and axes_order ('sagittal','vertical','frontal') i.e. (AP, DV, ML) -- confirms the project convention of exporting per-cell atlas coordinates already in microns, same axis order, for direct Points() ingestion with no further transform.
